proves.claim: parseCommandArgs accepts --level light, mid or strong and returns it as values.route, the same value --route gives.

cli.io-cli-main-options.level-and-route-.why: Without it, the approved --level name would reach commands as an unknown value and every command that reads values.route would ignore it.

proves.claim: Giving --level and --route with different values refuses with the USAGE code.

cli.io-cli-main-options.level-and-route-.why: Without it, one of the two values would win silently and the seat would run on a route its caller did not mean.
